prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1349; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state whether you consent to this call being recorded.

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on the highway in Baytown, in the right lane, heading toward the interchange. I needed to move over to the left lane to get to my exit.

Q: What happened when you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and saw a gap, so I signaled and started to move over. I didn't see the other car coming up in my blind spot. It sideswiped the left side of my vehicle, and I felt a hard jolt. My car pushed toward the median before I got it under control.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before or after contact?

A: Only after. I heard a loud scrape and then saw it pulling away in the lane beside me.

Q: Did you stop, or did you keep driving?

A: I pulled onto the shoulder. My head had hit the side window, and I was dizzy and my ears were ringing.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that same day. They diagnosed me with a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, I still get headaches, and bright lights bother me. I've been off work and seeing my doctor regularly.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered it. Thank you.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
